If you’re dreaming of Egypt in comfort, romance, and pure discovery, a 5 day Nile cruise Luxor to Aswan is one of the most rewarding ways to experience the Nile Valley. Over five days, you’ll sail through landscapes made famous by pharaohs, glide past riverbank villages, and step into some of the world’s most iconic ancient sites—while enjoying hotel-level service onboard. At Egypt Tours Meritamun, we focus on thoughtful planning, smooth transfers, and a truly memorable rhythm: sunrise temple visits, afternoon sailing, and evenings that feel like a private celebration on the Nile.

Why choose a 5-day Luxor to Aswan itinerary?

This route is perfectly paced for first-time visitors and repeat travelers alike. You’ll cover the highlights of Upper Egypt—Luxor’s grand monuments, the magnificent temples along the Nile, and the spiritual atmosphere of Aswan. The best part? You don’t waste time packing and unpacking between hotels. Your ship becomes your base as the scenery changes around you. While many trips are rushed, this Luxor to Aswan Nile cruise offers the ideal balance between iconic sightseeing and relaxed onboard time, so you can actually absorb Egypt’s history instead of simply “checking off” stops.

Day-by-day: Temples, river views & timeless nights

Day 1: Arrive in Luxor & settle into your Nile cruise

Arrive in Luxor and transfer to your cruise ship. After a warm welcome and time to unwind, enjoy an onboard overview and settle into your cabin. In the late afternoon or evening, you can explore Luxor at a comfortable pace before dinner onboard. As night falls, the Nile comes alive with golden reflections—an unforgettable start to your journey.

Day 2: Luxor’s West Bank—Valley of the Kings & more

Your adventure continues with a special day on Luxor’s West Bank. You’ll visit major sites connected with royal tombs and mortuary traditions, including the Valley of the Kings and nearby historical attractions that reveal how ancient Egypt prepared for eternity. Guided commentary adds depth to every stop—helping you see not just monuments, but the meaning behind the artistry. After a full day of history, return to the ship for dinner and a serene Nile night.

Day 3: Sail to Edfu & discover the Temple of Horus

After breakfast, enjoy a relaxed morning sailing downstream. The Nile views become the highlight—sunlight, water, palm-lined banks, and passing village life. In the afternoon, you’ll reach Edfu, home to the spectacular Temple of Horus. Known for its impressive scale and well-preserved details, it’s one of Egypt’s most impressive temple experiences. Back onboard, dinner is followed by an atmosphere of quiet luxury—perfect for unwinding after days of exploration.

Day 4: Kom Ombo & Aswan arrival

Today, you’ll stop at Kom Ombo, where the temple complex celebrates both military and fertility deities. The carvings and layout offer a fascinating look at how ancient Egyptians honored multiple aspects of life. As you continue sailing, the horizon shifts and the pace of the river journey feels even more intimate. Upon arrival in Aswan, you can enjoy the city’s changing lights and the feeling of having traveled into the true heart of Upper Egypt.

Day 5: Aswan experiences & unforgettable farewell

Your final day includes Aswan’s most memorable moments. Depending on your preferences, you may enjoy cultural and scenic experiences around the city and its legendary river setting. It’s a day to savor—slowly—before your cruise concludes. When you say goodbye to the ship, you’ll realize the journey wasn’t only about destinations. It was the feeling of moving through history, day after day, with comfort and care.

A 5-day cruise is as much about how you travel as what you see. Onboard amenities can include spacious cabins, attentive service, and dining designed to refresh you between temple visits.
